title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 10: the proverbs of Solomon contrasting the righteous and the wicked, the diligent and the lazy.

questions.text: According to the first proverb of Solomon, what does a wise son do?
questions.explanation: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

questions.text: What does the hand of the diligent bring, in contrast with a lazy hand?
questions.explanation: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

questions.text: Who is called a son who causes shame?
questions.explanation: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

answers.text: He who sleeps during the harvest

questions.text: This chapter contrasts the memory of the righteous with the name of the wicked: what happens to the name of the wicked?
questions.explanation: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

questions.text: How does the saying continue: "Hatred stirs up strife, but love..."?
questions.explanation: The proverb says: hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

questions.text: According to this chapter, who acts wisely where there is a multitude of words?
questions.explanation: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

questions.text: What is the tongue of the righteous compared to?
questions.explanation: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little worth.

questions.text: What happens to the wicked when the whirlwind passes?
questions.explanation: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more, but the righteous stand firm forever.

answers.text: He hides in his strong city

questions.text: What is the sluggard like to those who send him?
questions.explanation: As vinegar to the teeth and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

answers.text: A broken sandal and a lame foot
Vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes
A leaking roof and a dripping rain
A snare and a stumbling block

questions.text: What is said about the wealth that Yahweh's blessing brings?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

answers.text: It must be shared with the poor
It passes to the children's children
It is greater than the wealth of kings
He adds no trouble to it
